bodyHtml:
Aquasky Pressure Tank 100L Design Change Notice

Aquasky Pressure Tank 100L New Design change. The 100L tank has a new version and the dimension comparison table as shows. The 100L design changes from a 4 shell design to a 2 shell design and increases the diameter. The advantage of the new design is able to lower the height to avoid a high percentage of shipping damage. The volume of the tank is adjusted accurately to 100L. The shipping volume also reduces 10% to be able to save the cost of shipping. The new version is going to be available in March 2020.    
MEGA-100 remains the same dimension.
